scope: Corollary 1.2 (Additivity with a finite-dimensional partner) of the manuscript “Classical capacity and entropy inequalities for generalized amplitude damping” (preprints/Classical-capacity-and-entropy-inequalities-for-generalized-amplitude-damping-September-24-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 276 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 5656514823b55d5a), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF pages 3-4. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. The quote crosses a page break and includes whatever the extraction places there, such as a page number. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let γ, ν ∈ [0, 1], put A = Aγ,ν, and let N : B(Hin) → B(Hout) be completely positive and trace preserving, where Hin and Hout are nonzero finite-dimensional complex Hilbert spaces. Then χ(A ⊗ N) = χ(A) + χ(N), (1.9) Smin(A ⊗ N) = Smin(A) + Smin(N), (1.10) C(A ⊗ N) = C(A) + C(N). (1.11) 3 Here χ is the unconstrained one-shot Holevo capacity in (1.3), and C is the regularized unassisted classical capacity in (1.4).
